phases.title: Orientation and survival phrases
phases.description: Build confidence with pronunciation, word order, greetings, and polite survival language.

modules.title: How Japanese sentences work
modules.canDoGoal: Recognize Japanese rhythm and form one safe Romaji-first sentence.

modules.title: Greetings and politeness
modules.canDoGoal: Open, close, and repair a short polite exchange.

phases.title: Core beginner sentences
phases.description: Use desu, wa, nouns, adjectives, and likes/dislikes for simple identity statements.

modules.title: Identity and description
modules.canDoGoal: Introduce oneself and describe familiar people or things.

phases.title: Daily actions
phases.description: Talk about common actions, places, and times using polite verbs and core particles.

modules.title: Daily verbs and objects
modules.canDoGoal: Describe a simple daily action with its object, destination, or location.
masteryCriteria: Uses o, ni, and de in practiced contexts

phases.title: Wants and plans
phases.description: Express wants, reasons, sequence, and simple future plans.

modules.title: Wants and reasons
modules.canDoGoal: State a simple desire and give one short reason.

sampleDrills.promptEnglish: I want to go to the park because it is quiet.
sampleDrills.expectedRomaji: Kouen ni ikitai desu. Shizuka desu kara.

masteryCriteria: Connects one plan to a reason

phases.title: Home, work, weather, and movement
phases.description: Connect movement and existence language to everyday places and conditions.

modules.title: Movement and existence
modules.canDoGoal: Say where people and things are and describe simple movement.

sampleDrills.promptEnglish: There is a library near home.
sampleDrills.expectedRomaji: Uchi no chikaku ni toshokan ga arimasu.

phases.title: Beginner conversation loops
phases.description: Ask and answer simple questions and recover when speech is unclear.

modules.title: Short exchanges and repair
modules.canDoGoal: Maintain a four-turn exchange and ask for clarification.
masteryCriteria: Uses a repair phrase without prompting

phases.title: Kana bridge
phases.description: Add hiragana and katakana recognition while retaining Romaji support.

modules.title: Sound-to-kana recognition
modules.canDoGoal: Recognize familiar words in kana without losing speaking momentum.

phases.title: Short stories
phases.description: Understand four-to-eight sentence stories that recycle mastered language.

modules.title: Recycled beginner stories
modules.canDoGoal: Follow a short familiar story and answer two comprehension questions.
masteryCriteria: New concepts remain below the story limit

phases.title: Early kanji awareness
phases.description: Introduce meaning-first kanji only from words already known in speech and kana.

modules.title: Meaning-first familiar kanji
modules.canDoGoal: Recognize a small set of kanji inside already-known words.

sampleDrills.promptEnglish: Which familiar word contains the kanji for water?
